stages.name: ingest
stages.description: Stream records from customer data source to Cerebras Cloud ingest endpoint. Batched at 1M records.

stages.name: fingerprint
stages.description: On-wafer 48-bit structural fingerprint per record. 1-to-1 map onto independent SHA-256 invocations.

stages.name: lsh_bucket
stages.description: Bucket by leading 16-bit prefix (~65,536 buckets). Distribute intra-bucket Hamming across cores.

stages.name: score
stages.description: Reconstruction + diversity + composite. Linear in N, wafer memory-bandwidth bound.

stages.name: null_test
stages.description: Seeded bit-shuffle + top-K mean across 1000 iterations, parallelized per-iteration.

stages.name: egress
stages.description: Write scored corpus + top-K ranking + SHA-256 reproducibility digest back to customer storage.

reproducibility_note: Cerebras compiles to static weight-mapped schedule. Same seed + same records → bit-identical output across wafer invocations. The SHA-256 digest of the top-K ranking is the audit-trail ID.
